# TranslateNote

An Obsidian desktop plugin (1.13.0+) using the existing OpenAI-compatible SDK client and editable review panel.

This fork adds per-request language selection (English/Swedish quick choices, configurable additional languages, persisted last choice), file-explorer Translate… with overwrite/review/new-file modes, protected Markdown prose translation, guarded writes and recovery copies.

Plugin ID: translate-note. Existing command IDs and provider settings are retained. Headings, metadata, whole links/aliases, code and supported structural syntax stay unchanged. Failed validation or conflicting writes do not overwrite the source. Backups are under the plugin's backups directory. New files copy frontmatter including any identity fields; see README for managed Dbox identity handling.

See README.md for supported behavior, limitations, manual installation and recovery.

Development: npm ci; npm run verify. Packaging additionally needs Python 3. Artifacts: dist/translate-note-0.3.0.zip, SHA256SUMS and BUILD.json. Tests use synthetic Obsidian/API hosts, not an installed Obsidian app or real provider.

origin: https://github.com/pcdahle/obsidian-llm-translate
upstream: https://github.com/Dmagg/obsidian-llm-translate
